conformance_checks: built-in: links, titles, sitemap coverage, canonical/OG head, JSON-LD, size budgets, locale checks; publish gated on pass
notes: Control. Measured from a 0.1.0-rc.1 development build (`cargo build --release --locked`, cold build about 32 s). The timed build includes .html.gz precompression at gzip's maximum level for every page, absent from all other frameworks; pages are rendered and compressed on every core, and files are created at most four at a time, the fastest setting measured on this file system. install=0 as a prebuilt single binary. `molde check` (render, every conformance check, gated publish) is a separate command: 477 ms on 1,901 pages, 9.7 ms on 5.
